# DN Electric LTD

> Licensed and insured master electricians serving Longmont, Boulder, and the Colorado Front Range. Founded by Master Electrician Matthew Gracia.

- Business: DN Electric LTD
- Founder: Matthew Gracia, Master Electrician
- Location: Longmont, CO 80501
- Phone: (720) 417-0758
- Email: scheduling@electricdn.com
- Hours: Mon–Fri 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM; Sat–Sun by appointment
- Primary service area (cities listed on electricdn.com): Longmont, Boulder, Loveland, Arvada, Frederick, Denver
- Extended Front Range coverage available — confirm by phone
- Licensed and insured for residential and commercial electrical work in Colorado

## Services
- /services/panel-upgrades — Residential panel upgrades and service changes
- /services/ev-charger-installations — Level 2 home and business EV chargers (Tesla, Ford, Rivian compatible)
- /services/lighting-design-and-installation — Light fixture installation and LED retrofits
- /services/smart-home-and-ev-ready — Smart home wiring and integration, EV-ready rough-in
- /services/battery-backup-and-generators — Whole-home battery backup and generator installation
- /services/commercial-electrical — Tenant improvements, lighting retrofits, commercial panel work
